text: Follow-up (after 102.001-T lands): update the upstream spike/SKILL.md.tmpl in the external autoharness repo so regeneration preserves the in-repo docline findings-artifact fix (Principle IV, no out-of-tree writes). Refs: 102.001-T, 102-F, docs/exec-plans/2026-07-13-spike-findings-docline-reconciliation-plan.md.

Enable (or formally waive) the formal multi-persona plan-review skill gate. This environment cannot dispatch independent reviewer persona sub-agents, so Stage plans (091-S through 093-S) ran an honest inline single-agent self-assessment instead of the formal .github/skills/plan-review/SKILL.md gate (AGENTS.md:378 orders plan-review -> harvest). Establish a real persona-dispatch path OR a documented operator waiver so the pre-harvest gate is satisfiable and not silently skipped. [ROUTING 2026-07-22: p3; route to a full Stage deliberation + decision outcome (real plan-review persona-dispatch path vs documented waiver).]

OS-crash / power-loss durability for the size event+write path (out of scope for 099-S, Copilot G3). Both shared writers are sync-free: atomicfile.WriteFileAtomic (internal/atomicfile/atomicfile.go:15-63) does temp-write -> Chmod -> Close -> Rename with NO fsync before rename; events.EventWriter.AppendEvent (internal/events/stream.go:40-64) does O_APPEND write with NO f.Sync. So the 099-S event-before-write ordering guarantees PROCESS-crash safety only, NOT OS-crash/power-loss. Closing that gap requires a separate fsync protocol coordinated across BOTH shared writers (fsync the appended event file AND the atomic temp file before rename, plus parent-dir fsync). This is cross-cutting (changes the whole repo write path, not just the size seam) and must be its own release unit with its own review. Follow-up: design a repo-wide durability/fsync protocol for atomicfile + events. [ROUTING 2026-07-22: route as an isolated spike workflow (repo-wide atomicfile+events fsync durability protocol); its own release unit.]

Crash-window exactly-once size mutation, deferred from 099-S per Copilot cycle-3 H1/H5 descope (Option B2). Requires stable transport-visible OpID ingress on the CLI/MCP interface (SE-5 exposes none and no caller carries one), deterministic multi-orphan event-ordering, and a reachable offline doctor reconciliation routed through the real internal/core/doctor.go Doctor() workspace scan (doctor_target.go is single-file validation-only and is never called by the scan). Cycle-3 removed SE-3c (108.011-T) and narrowed SE-3b (108.006-T) to best-effort append-before-write audit ordering with fail-closed read (durable custom_fields.size is source of truth; orphan events ignored on read). Out of scope for a size-estimation feature; revisit only if exactly-once crash-window semantics become a product requirement. [ROUTING 2026-07-22: route as a distinct spike workflow (crash-window exactly-once size mutation feasibility); its own release unit.]

MCP list_items request-contract parity: evaluate adding priority/owner filters to backlogit_list_items to match CLI list. Deferred from 117-F adversarial review (Parity-P2). NOTE: compound learnings caution against unilaterally widening request-contract asymmetry between CLI and MCP; this needs a deliberation on whether both surfaces should gain the filters together, not a one-sided add. [ROUTING 2026-07-22: p2; route to a Stage deliberation before any code (CLI/MCP request-contract parity decision).]

Add composite SQLite index idx_items_parent_type_id on items(parent_id, artifact_type, id) to speed feature-child lookups used by size_composition batched rollups (GetTaskChildrenByParentIDs / childIDsByParent). Deferred from 117-F review (SQLite-P3); measure query plan before/after. [ROUTING 2026-07-22: p1 next round of work; bundle FD8C4094 into one deliverable/shipment.]

Fix misleading _txlock comment on db.GetItemsByIDs (internal/db): the comment references transaction/write-lock semantics that do not apply to this read path. Pre-existing, surfaced in 117-F review (SQLite-P3 advisory). Comment-only correction. [ROUTING 2026-07-22: bundled into the 0FA55F47 p1 deliverable (comment-only correction).]
